summary: China SXT Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K reporting an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with Univest Securities, LLC, to issue and sell up to $100M of Class A ordinary shares under an existing shelf registration statement. The ATM program is a routine capital-raising mechanism, not a special situation. The company pays 3% commission plus a $0.003 per share trading fee. The filing includes standard representations, indemnification, and termination provisions. No premium, special board recommendation, or structural change is involved; this is an ordinary equity distribution facility.
